lines.text: Unlocks: Clear stage 6600105

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Commander.
Howdy, what's up?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Such a cute reply!
Is everything all right?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Eunhwa says she has something to say.
Okay, what is it?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You always work so hard for us.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I have complete faith in you, and know that you'll continue working hard.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I know I'm not good at expressing myself,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but I've always felt that you're someone I can depend on.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: So, thank you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If you want, I'll allow you to touch my forehead.
Um... okay?
I appreciate you saying that, Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: What the hell is going on here?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Uh-oh! Busted:'(

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Don't make it seem like I would use such stupid emojis.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Er... hehe...
What's going on?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I was messing around with Eunhwa's phone,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and I got caught :D

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: When did you swap phones?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I switched them when Eunhwa wasn't looking :P

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I was going to stop there and give it back,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but since today is April Fool's Day, I decided to take it a bit further.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Who cares what day it is?! Who said you could use my phone?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Sorry :'(

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Fine, just quit blubbering.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Shut up already!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I know you're flat as a board,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but that's no reason to be so angry all the time.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: You do realize that since you're using my phone,

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: in a way, you're insulting yourself.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: AAAGGGHHH!! Now I'm upset :'(

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Commander, do something!
Could you two please switch back your phones? It's hard to keep everything straight.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Move your ass and put my phone back where you found it.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Don't make me repeat myself, or else I won't say it so nicely next time.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: There wasn't anything nice about how you said that!

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I'm putting this phone on silent.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: You stop sending messages as well, Weakling.
